newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Supreme Defence Council met on Wednesday to appoint its new members following elections last month. By law, Romania's president, prime minister, interior and industry ministers are members.
* Romanian diplomat Octavian Filip, a commercial attache of the Romanian embassy in Peru, is one of 200 hostages held by left-wing rebels in Lima in the Japanese ambassador's residence.
Filip is well and was able to speak to his family, Romanian ambassador to Lima, Alexandru Ionete told national radio.
He said Filip told his wife the hostages were treated well and there was no need to worry for their lives.
* Foreign ministry official Cristian Lazarescu said the ministry was in constant touch with authorities in Lima.
* Senate Chairman Petre Roman met journalists on Wednesday to improve the image of Romania's parliament in the eyes of the media and the public.
* The OTC market is trading shares of more than 1,200 companies, Stefan Boboc, the president of the National securities Commission said. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
